follow-up time: Median of 6 months post-niche repair for pregnancy attempts
cohort: 37 women who underwent laparoscopic niche repair by a single high-skilled surgeon between July 2014 and March 2019
finding: Laparoscopic niche repair resulted in a good pregnancy rate (60%) with a low pregnancy complication rate and favorable pregnancy outcomes, with all births being cesarean deliveries and no reported dehiscence or rupture.
mod_finding: All women in the study who achieved pregnancy after laparoscopic niche repair gave birth by cesarean delivery.
